note: tcg#55 shrank the graph interface to what torch cannot know. v3's lifted_inputs, specialization and pytree in/out were read by nothing in torchcg or the gen-worker; constant_fqns and literal_values are derived from the ExportedProgram in declare(); the ingress is promoted to a top-level field. Graph specializations are content addressed, so the rekey needs no migration -- the next derive republishes. placement is now ALWAYS recorded (pgw#1458): dropping it for single-device graphs is what made a cpu-traced/cuda-minted mismatch surface as an AOTInductor internal assert. tcg#56 (Paul: "I like graph-specialization better") renamed the vocabulary: a target has ONE graph and MANY graph SPECIALIZATIONS. `class_dims` -> `specialization_dims` and `class_hash` -> `specialization_hash`. The FORMAT VERSION IS STILL 4 and this is deliberate: `specialization_dims` is folded into the hash by name, so the rename is a REKEY (680f3e1a251975b7 -> 9d08563a90465af6 on this vector), and it was folded into v4's existing rekey rather than cutting v5 -- one fleet-wide invalidation instead of two, which is why the rename was ordered in the same week. `graph_witness` is UNCHANGED (54ceeee7225e57c9): it digests the program body, not the fact keys, which bounds the rekey to exactly the renamed key.
